description: Country info API: ISO 3166 codes, currency (ISO 4217), calling code, official languages, time zones, weekend days and first day of the week for 249 countries and territories, including all 54 African countries, India, the Gulf and Asia. Also 12h or 24h clock, units and paper size. Sources: Unicode CLDR 48.2, IANA tz 2026e, Google libphonenumber. Useful for forms, invoicing, localisation and scheduling around local weekends. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country codes, comma-separated, up to 60 (default: all 249 countries and territories)

name: country_info_lookup
title: Country info: ISO codes, currency, calling code, languages, time zones and weekends (249 countries)
